title: SSC GD Constable CBT Ends Today May 30 - 39,481 Vacancies, Result July 2026, PET/PST Next
author: Ash K.
summary: SSC GD Constable 2026 Computer Based Test (CBT) concludes today, May 30, 2026 - the final day of Phase 4. Exam ran April 27 to May 30 across 4 phases. 39,481 vacancies in BSF, CISF, CRPF, ITBP, SSB, Assam Rifles, SSF, NCB. Provisional answer key expected within 2–3 weeks. CBT Result expected July 2026. PET/PST (physical test) to follow for shortlisted candidates.
body: The SSC GD Constable 2026 Computer Based Test (CBT) concludes today - May 30, 2026. Phase 4 of the exam ran from May 25 to May 30, marking the end of the largest constable-level recruitment exam in India. The entire CBT phase ran from April 27 to May 30, 2026 across four phases at hundreds of exam centres nationwide. A total of 39,481 vacancies are up for grabs across BSF, CISF, CRPF, ITBP, SSB, Assam Rifles (Rifleman GD), SSF, and NCB (Sepoy).

DetailInformation
CBT End DateMay 30, 2026 (today - Phase 4 final day)
CBT Start DateApril 27, 2026
Total Vacancies39,481 posts
Forces CoveredBSF, CISF, CRPF, ITBP, SSB, Assam Rifles, SSF, NCB
EligibilityClass 10 pass | Age 18–23 years
CBT Pattern80 Qs | 160 marks | 60 minutes | 0.25 negative marking
Provisional Answer KeyExpected within 2–3 weeks at ssc.gov.in
CBT Result DateExpected July 2026
Next StagePET/PST (Physical Efficiency & Standard Test)
PET Conducted ByCRPF on behalf of all CAPFs
Starting SalaryPay Level 3 - ₹21,700–₹69,100/month + allowances

What happens next - the full roadmap: Once the CBT concludes today, SSC will release the provisional answer key at ssc.gov.in within 2–3 weeks. Candidates will have a 4–5 day window to raise objections at ₹100 per question. The final answer key follows. The CBT result is expected in July 2026, listing roll numbers of candidates shortlisted for PET/PST. Approximately 10–12 times the number of vacancies are shortlisted.

PET/PST requirements (Physical Efficiency Test): Male candidates must run 5 km in 24 minutes. Female candidates must run 1.6 km in 8.5 minutes. Candidates from Ladakh region have modified standards. Height requirements: Male General/OBC/SC - 170 cm; Male ST - 162.5 cm; Female General/OBC/SC - 157 cm; Female ST - 150 cm. PET is qualifying in nature - marks are NOT added to the final merit list. Only CBT marks determine merit.

Medical examination and document verification: Candidates who clear PET/PST proceed to a Detailed Medical Examination (DME) conducted by respective forces. Vision standards, colour blindness tests, and other physical checks are carried out. After DME, document verification confirms eligibility. The final merit list is released force-wise and category-wise after all stages conclude.

If your exam went well - start physical prep now: The PET/PST is where many candidates lose out despite clearing CBT. Running 5 km in 24 minutes requires consistent training. With the result expected in July and PET likely August–September 2026, you have 2–3 months to build stamina. Start today. See our SSC CHSL exam guide for another SSC opportunity, or check the SSC CPO guide for Sub-Inspector posts in CAPFs.

faqs.question: When does SSC GD Constable 2026 CBT end?
faqs.answer: SSC GD Constable 2026 CBT ends today - May 30, 2026. Phase 4 (May 25–30) is the final phase. The exam started on April 27, 2026 and ran across four phases at centres across India.

faqs.question: How many vacancies are in SSC GD Constable 2026?
faqs.answer: SSC GD Constable 2026 has 39,481 vacancies across BSF, CISF, CRPF, ITBP, SSB, Assam Rifles (Rifleman GD), Secretariat Security Force (SSF), and Narcotics Control Bureau (Sepoy).

faqs.question: When will SSC GD 2026 CBT result be declared?
faqs.answer: SSC GD Constable 2026 CBT result is expected in July 2026 at ssc.gov.in. Before the result, SSC will release a provisional answer key within 2–3 weeks of the last exam date, followed by a challenge window.

faqs.question: What is the PET requirement for SSC GD Constable 2026?
faqs.answer: Male candidates must run 5 km in 24 minutes. Female candidates must run 1.6 km in 8.5 minutes. Ladakh region candidates have modified standards. PET is qualifying - marks are not added to merit. Only CBT marks count for final selection.

faqs.question: What is the SSC GD Constable 2026 salary?
faqs.answer: SSC GD Constable is a Pay Level 3 post - ₹21,700 to ₹69,100 per month. Add House Rent Allowance (8–24% of basic depending on city), Transport Allowance, Ration Allowance, and other CAPF-specific benefits.

faqs.question: Who conducts the PET/PST for SSC GD Constable 2026?
faqs.answer: The Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Physical Standard Test (PST) for SSC GD Constable 2026 is conducted by CRPF on behalf of all CAPFs. Dates are announced after CBT result declaration.

callout.heading: CBT Done? Start Running Today
callout.content: PET/PST is where candidates who cleared CBT lose out on selection. 5 km in 24 minutes requires real stamina - not something you build in a week. Result comes in July; PET likely August–September. Start your physical training now. Every day counts.
